definition.defect: relative L2 difference of P_K G6(P_K eta, P_K xi) between independently constructed N=1024 and N=2048 grids

limitations: The complete 548360-row historical rejected population is unavailable.
The historical panel is deterministic but not a random sample of every rejected trajectory frame.
The tolerance is provisional until a larger N,2N,4N calibration panel is run.
